title: Has anyone been to the big empty theatre?
content: In my dreams it looks a bit different than that, I am never on the stage and the space inside is bigger and causes me an unpleasant feeling of anxiety of being in a vast enclosed space with no windows. The colours are more ochre and brown. There are things inside that make me feel small (imagine being shrunk and put into the insides of a big mechanical clock or something like that, it's hard to explain). It is located in the underlayers of the mall.
